procedure.method: I read the explicitly pinned packet, case, review rules, rubric, helper code, ratio policy and three native-evidence manifests; I verified their hashes and each PNG hash/header dimension. No embedded unpinned paths were followed. The packet has no source assets or protected-layout measurement manifests. I then made nine sequential tools.view_image calls inside functions.exec, using detail original and emitting each returned image with image(..., original): M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M2 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M3 native, usage720, thumbnail320. I visually inspected all nine returned images before making the first transcription judgment, any image score or the set-diversity score. Copy was read visually from those full native views and checked for layout/readability against the supplied smaller views; no OCR, crop, regenerated image or revisit was used. This describes actual viewing, not an invented trace serialization. I worked independently without spawning/forking/resuming or inspecting peer reports. I cannot observe a runner thread ID, so session_id is null.

content_form.location: left street versus the clear right text column
content_form.observation: The concrete urban illustration and its simplified spatial continuation connect the city subject to representation while leaving the bilingual practical information on a separate readable field.

hierarchy.location: right column, title through program and registration
hierarchy.observation: Large Korean and English titles lead to the forum name, date and venue; the time column orders five program rows, and orange registration lines distinguish the action from navy supporting copy.
Both title languages retain an obvious rank; orange registration remains locatable, while the detailed body becomes too small for full thumbnail reading.

typography.location: right column, bilingual title and five program rows
typography.observation: Hangul and Latin glyphs are clean; bold times form one vertical track. Three longer program entries put the English continuation beneath the Korean line without losing the slash or any words.
Small English lines and the protected URL/email characters remain readable. The long audience line nearly fills the column but does not collide with its edge or another line.

space.location: x522–994 information column and left illustration
space.observation: The title, rules and lower blocks share a stable left edge; full-height image bleed is balanced by an untextured cream reading field. The transition between illustration and type reserves a usable text lane.
Rules separate program, audience/admission, registration, contact and organizer. Group gaps exceed the spacing inside each bilingual pair, preserving the information groups.

image_material.location: left foreground trunk, glazing, planters and pavement
image_material.observation: Painted foliage, rough bark, reflected blue glazing and patterned paving use a consistent illustrative treatment. Shadowed paving and repeated facade edges maintain a readable street depth.
The simplified pale shapes use clean edges and a limited flat treatment next to the richer street, so the material change reads as deliberate visual reduction rather than damaged detail.

emotion_control.observation: Sunlit greens and the warm doorway make the event welcoming and lively; the dark navy bilingual information and ruled schedule supply the requested trustworthy institutional tone.

emotion_control.location: orange registration pair beneath the deadline
emotion_control.observation: The warm accent is concentrated on registration instead of competing with every section, giving the lively color a practical role.

ai_slop.observation: Trees, paving, windows and planters belong to the depicted street; there are no stray symbolic labels, invented logos, unreadable pseudo-copy or numerical map ornaments.
The main scene terminates in coherent pale spatial shapes; the information rules and the repeated bilingual blocks remain clean instead of breaking into decorative fragments.

residuals: At thumbnail size the detailed program and footer are too small for full reading; the titles, scene and orange application cue survive.
The data relationship relies on the visible representational reduction; it is less explicit than a depicted observation/analysis action and does not warrant an exceptional score.

R7-B02-M2.assessment: A professionally constructed architectural poster with clear bilingual practical information, but the large scene shows attractive urban work/courtyard life without a visible observation-to-data relationship. That literal visual condition fails; content_form is 3. The rendering and typography are independently strong.

emotion_control.observation: Orange, yellow and mint provide the requested energy, while navy copy and a structured schedule preserve trust. The two-handed assembly adds an active collaborative gesture appropriate to the joint forum.

The collaboration gesture survives reduction and feels participatory rather than merely ornamental. Its emotional intent is more specific than the neutral streetscape or courtyard in the other members.

ai_slop.location: middle fragment scene and large gripping hands
ai_slop.observation: Hands attach visibly to the pieces; trees, benches, lamps and people belong to recognizable urban settings. The outlines and seam serve the assembly action rather than forming arbitrary floating icons.

ai_slop.location: top schedule and bottom practical panels
ai_slop.observation: There are no invented legends, statistical figures, sponsors or pseudo-labels. Colored URL emphasis has a practical function and the bilingual copy remains complete.

residuals: The five program rows outrank the event metadata through size and placement; date and location sit in a disproportionately small central block.
The main English title is strongly condensed, and the crowded overall information load limits exceptional refinement despite intact readable copy.

evidence.location: whole composition
evidence.observation: A vertical illustrated streetscape/abstraction on the left and a continuous right-hand information column give M1 a distinct editorial structure. It differs materially from M2's architectural collage and M3's held city fragments; the difference is more than color.

evidence.location: whole composition
evidence.observation: A rendered cutaway courtyard surrounds a central title/program field, with metadata upper-left and a split footer. This changes depth treatment, image construction and reading geometry relative to M1, while its generic venue scene is the weakest specific data concept of the set.

evidence.location: whole composition
evidence.observation: A full-width schedule leads into a large title, two hands assembling city fragments and colored practical panels. The visible assembly action distinguishes its concept from both M1's representational reduction and M2's urban work setting.

residuals: All three share navy bilingual type, light reading fields, sunlit vegetation and warm urban architecture, limiting exceptional breadth.
M2 fails the literal observation/data relationship condition; M3 retains a hierarchy score of 3. Neither weakness is canceled by the set-diversity score.
